title: Korean-Style Pan-Fried Tofu with Citrusy German Twist
description: A fusion twist on traditional German cuisine, this dish combines the bold flavors of Korea with the comfort of a hearty skillet meal.

ingredients.name: skillet oil
ingredients.notes: such as canola or avocado oil

ingredients.name: german seasonings (such as paprika, caraway, or marjoram)

instructions: Heat the skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the korean chili flakes, grated ginger, citrus juice, and german seasonings (if using).
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional citrus wedges (optional).
